description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Rite of Passage until end of turn.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Mirage Mirror trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 6 as desired.

uses.name: Walking Ballista
uses.cardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it
